artifactScope: Reviewer facts transcribed from retrieved source text, not raw publication bytes
title: Measuring Wood Moisture & Drying Time for Hardwood Tree Species (FS-1074)

method.place: Western Maryland, Piedmont and Blue Ridge
method.preparation: split, stacked on pallets, uncovered; shade until mid-morning
method.measurement: A.W. Perkins meter; monthly for one year; 3 pieces/species/time; each split and measured near both ends and in middle
method.basis: Report gives meter percentages, does not explicitly establish a wet-mass basis.

limits: Species and exposed interior matter. No matched island weather series, exact split thickness or oven-dry mass time series acquired.
